cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I whistled like you. Up it goes. The table can float while we pack, but put a mat under that wet cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was calling the cat. The table's at the ceiling; I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cat called, yes. Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Use the stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up. I've still got my muddy boots on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! You'll grind mud into every tread. Give me the cup before you touch anything else.

reason: Make copied whistling a mistaken command and let B correct it before offering useful help. Attach the mud concern to established ladder treads rather than assuming B stands on the floating tabletop.
